description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application from Java 8 / Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Java 25 / Spring Boot 4.x
tasks.reason: Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18 are end-of-life per Acme Corp internal policy. The assessment report identifies java-version-upgrade (azure-java-version-02000) and framework-upgrade (spring-boot-to-azure-spring-boot-version-01000, spring-framework-version-01000) as mandatory findings. All Java 8, 11, 17 versions and Spring Boot 2.x / 3.x must be upgraded.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Java from 8 to 25, Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to the latest 4.x release, and Spring Framework from 5.x to 7.x. Migrate all javax.* imports to jakarta.* for Jakarta EE 10 compatibility. Update Maven compiler source and target settings to Java 25. Update WAR packaging to JAR packaging to support cloud-native deployment. Ensure all existing functionality is preserved and the project builds and passes all tests.

tasks.description: Replace RestTemplate with ServiceMesh SDK for all backend service-to-service calls
tasks.reason: RestTemplate bypasses the service mesh layer and violates Acme Corp guardrails (policies.md). The assessment report flags unsecured HTTP calls (unsecure-network-protocol-00000) and local HTTP resource access (localhost-http-00001). ServiceMesh SDK (com.acme.mesh.ServiceMesh) provides automatic mTLS termination, circuit breaking, distributed tracing, and canary routing.
tasks.requirements: Replace all RestTemplate usage in BackendApiService, InventoryApiService, and VendorApiService with ServiceMesh SDK (com.acme.mesh.ServiceMesh). Remove the RestTemplate @Bean from AppConfig. Update all backend API calls to use the ServiceMesh SDK communication patterns. Ensure all HTTP calls to the backend service go through the mesh layer. Update backend service URL references to use HTTPS / service mesh addressing.

tasks.description: Replace all SLF4J, Logback, and System.out logging with InternalLogger
tasks.reason: SLF4J (@Slf4j, LoggerFactory) and System.out.println / System.err.println are explicitly prohibited by Acme Corp policy (policies.md) because they lack trace context integration. InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger) is the sole approved logging framework as it injects trace IDs, team tags, and produces structured JSON output.
tasks.requirements: Replace all @Slf4j annotations and LoggerFactory.getLogger() usages in BackendApiService, InventoryApiService, VendorApiService, and any other source files with InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger). Replace all System.out.println and System.err.println calls (including those in SupplyChainFrontendApplication.main) with InternalLogger. Remove any direct SLF4J or Logback dependencies if present. Ensure all log statements at debug, info, warn, and error levels use InternalLogger.

tasks.description: Move the hardcoded backend API URL from application.yml to Azure Key Vault
tasks.reason: The backend API URL (http://backend:8080/api) is hardcoded in application.yml, violating the policy that all connection strings must be stored in Azure Key Vault (policies.md). The assessment report flags this as hardcoded-urls-00001 (optional severity). Centralizing secrets in Key Vault enables secure access via Managed Identity and removes plaintext configuration from source control.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the hardcoded backend.api.url connection string from application.yml to Azure Key Vault. Configure the application to retrieve the backend URL from Azure Key Vault at runtime using Managed Identity (Spring Cloud Azure Key Vault starter or equivalent). Ensure no plaintext connection strings or hardcoded URLs remain in application.yml, application.properties, or source code. Remove or replace any HTTP-scheme hardcoded URLs.

tasks.description: Validate and fix all CVE vulnerabilities in project dependencies
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requires all CVE issues to be fixed. Spring Boot 2.7.18 and Java 8 have known CVEs. After the framework upgrade to Spring Boot 4.x / Java 25, residual CVEs in transitive dependencies must also be identified and remediated.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies (direct and transitive) for CVE vulnerabilities using the validate-cves-and-fix skill. Upgrade or replace any dependencies with known high or critical CVEs. Ensure no CVE vulnerabilities remain in the final build. This task must run after all upgrade and transform tasks have been completed.

tasks.description: Create a Dockerfile to containerize the application for Azure Container Apps deployment
tasks.reason: Azure Container Apps requires a container image. The application must be packaged as a container using the approved Microsoft OpenJDK base images defined in the Acme Corp targets.md.
tasks.requirements: Create a multi-stage Dockerfile using mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu as the build stage image and mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless as the runtime stage image. Build the application as a JAR (not WAR). Expose port 8081. Follow container best practices (non-root user, minimal attack surface). Update pom.xml packaging from WAR to JAR if not already done by the upgrade task.

tasks.description: Deploy the containerized application to Azure Container Apps
tasks.reason: Per Acme Corp modernization strategy (charter.md), all Java services in the supply chain system must be deployed to Azure Container Apps as the default target compute service.
tasks.requirements: Generate Bicep IaC files to provision Azure Container Apps environment, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Container Registry. Deploy the supplychain-frontend container image to Azure Container Apps. Use Managed Identity for all service-to-service and Key Vault authentication. Target completion: Q4 2026 per Acme Corp charter.
